parsed_json.up: Define compound set: parent CHEMBL376359 plus all salts via molecule_hierarchy (parent_molregno = parent.molregno). Join FAQ provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records on molregno -> activities on record_id -> docs on doc_id -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on tid. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter: standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'. Compute pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id, falling back to doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. No row limit.
